principle: LOSSLESS distillation of mined Kaggle kernels -> candidate registry entries; keeps raw freq + lineage; serves_truth=false; candidates only (promotion boundary applies).
llm_note: set OH_LLM_API_KEY + --live for Kimi/GLM/Claude per-kernel distillation

distilled_candidates.description: The HuggingFace `transformers` library — load pretrained encoder/decoder/causal-LM checkpoints behind a uniform AutoModel/AutoTokenizer API across thousands of architectures.
use_cases: Load an LLM or embedding model by name without architecture-specific code
Swap model backbones behind one API to compare accuracy/cost
Tokenize and run inference for classification, generation, or feature extraction

distilled_candidates.description: Partition the data into k folds, train on k-1 and validate on the held-out fold rotating — estimates generalization without a separate holdout and yields out-of-fold predictions.
use_cases: Estimate true generalization error on small/medium datasets
Produce out-of-fold predictions for stacking/blending
Tune hyperparameters against a stable CV score, not one split

distilled_candidates.description: Average or weight-blend the predictions of several independently-trained models to cut variance and lift accuracy over any single model.
use_cases: Blend folds/seeds to stabilize a noisy single-model score
Combine diverse families (GBM + NN) whose errors are uncorrelated
Late-fuse probabilities before thresholding for a calibration gain

distilled_candidates.description: The full cross-validation loop: repeatedly fit and score across folds and aggregate the per-fold metric (mean ± std) as the model-selection signal.
use_cases: Report mean±std across folds rather than one fragile score
Compare candidate models on identical fold splits for a fair A/B
Detect overfitting via a large train-vs-CV gap

distilled_candidates.description: The `bitsandbytes` library for 8-bit/4-bit quantized weights and optimizers — fit larger models on limited VRAM with minimal accuracy loss.
use_cases: Serve a model that wouldn't otherwise fit on one consumer GPU
Cut inference memory/cost while keeping near-FP16 quality
Use 8-bit Adam to train larger models within a memory budget

distilled_candidates.description: The decoding parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k, repetition_penalty, max_new_tokens, num_beams) that shape an LLM's output distribution at inference time.
use_cases: Trade determinism vs creativity via temperature/top_p
Suppress repetition/looping with repetition_penalty/no_repeat_ngram
Cap latency and cost with max_new_tokens and beam count

distilled_candidates.description: `trust_remote_code=True` executes arbitrary model-repo Python at load time — a supply-chain RISK that must be gated to vetted publishers, never enabled blindly.
use_cases: Flag/deny loading untrusted checkpoints that require remote code
Pin to a reviewed commit/publisher before enabling
Audit which pipeline steps set this flag as a security control

distilled_candidates.description: A fast histogram-based gradient-boosted-trees library — a top performer on tabular data with strong defaults, native categorical handling, and low training cost.
use_cases: Strong (often winning) baseline on tabular regression/classification
Train fast on large row counts where deep nets underperform
Get feature importance and fast iteration for tabular EDA

distilled_candidates.description: The `lightgbm` import — entry point to LightGBM's sklearn-style and native training APIs.
use_cases: Drop-in gradient-boosting baseline via LGBMClassifier/LGBMRegressor
Use the native Dataset/train API for custom objectives/callbacks
Early-stop on a validation set to avoid overfit

distilled_candidates.description: A leading instruction that sets the model's role, constraints, and output contract for the whole conversation, separate from per-turn user input.
use_cases: Pin a persona, tone, or safety policy across a session
Declare the output schema/format the model must follow
Inject tool/skill instructions the user shouldn't have to repeat

distilled_candidates.description: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (LoRA/adapters/prefix-tuning) — adapt a frozen base by training a tiny set of added weights, cutting fine-tune cost and storage by orders of magnitude.
use_cases: Fine-tune a large model on one GPU by training only adapters
Ship many task-specific adapters over one shared base
Combine with a 4-bit base (QLoRA) for cheap domain adaptation

distilled_candidates.description: The model-specific token format that frames multi-turn roles (system/user/assistant) — the correct template is required for instruction-tuned models to behave as trained.
use_cases: Format messages with the exact special tokens a chat model expects
Port a prompt across models by swapping templates, not text
Avoid silent quality loss from a mismatched or absent template

distilled_candidates.description: Load weights in 4-bit (NF4/FP4) precision so a large checkpoint fits in a fraction of the VRAM — a small quality drop for a large memory/cost saving.
use_cases: Run a 13B+ model on a single mid-range GPU
Stretch a fixed VRAM budget to a larger, more capable model
Pair with QLoRA to fine-tune a quantized base cheaply

distilled_candidates.description: Load weights in 8-bit precision — roughly half the memory of FP16 with negligible accuracy loss for most inference.
use_cases: Halve inference memory with near-lossless quality
Serve more concurrent requests per GPU
A safer default than 4-bit when quality is critical
